content.text: The agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire, or employee-poaching covenant anywhere.

input.quote: 10.2 No Joint Venture. The Parties agree that and acknowledge that the relationship of the Parties is in the nature of an independent contractor. This Agreement shall not be deemed to create a partnership or joint venture and neither Party is the other's agent, partner, employee or representative.
input.rationale:
We reviewed the full agreement, including Section 5.4 (General Managers), the exclusivity provisions in Section 6, and the general provisions in Section 10, and searched for "solicit", "employ", "hire" and "induce". The only employment-related references are incidental (confidentiality references to HDI's employees in p0051 and the independent-contractor language in p0061); there is no non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant binding the Company anywhere in the document. This meets the preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer), so no redline is warranted. Note that the Section 6 restrictive covenants are commercial exclusivity obligations, not personnel restrictions, and are addressed under other rules.</rationale>
